digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions mirror CI for main branch
propositions: Mirror CI runs on main display red X's (cancelled status) when commits land close together, making a healthy main appear broken.
Four of five major Gerrit-primary GitHub mirrors run NO per-commit CI on the mirror at all; Gerrit's pre-merge gate is the real protection.
GitHub Actions renders cancelled runs as red X's with no native suppression mechanism; deleted-run workarounds destroy the record and fail open.
Scheduled main-health runs every 6 hours replace per-commit CI, publish the last-known-green SHA as a bisect lower bound, and emit a copy-pasteable git bisect recipe on failure.

All six workflows with push-to-main triggers are edited to drop push.refs/heads/main matching; three cheap lanes gain 6-hourly schedules; three expensive or separate workflows keep their cadences unchanged.
Pre-merge Gerrit verification (Verified +1 gate) is unchanged; gerrit-verify.yaml, both reconcilers, external-integration.yml, and all four reusable workflow_call modules are not modified.
